customManagers.description: Update Makefile tool versions via inline renovate comments

packageRules.description: Wait 3 days before automerging major updates
Group GitHub Actions into one PR
Bump Go version in go.mod to latest patch

Group tool-version bumps (.mise.toml + the remaining Makefile pins) into one PR. minimumReleaseAge 3 days covers the aqua tag-before-publish race: aqua-backed tools get a git tag before their GitHub Release artifacts publish, so `mise install` 404s on a same-day bump.

cloud-provider-kind is tracked by a custom.regex manager with datasource=docker, but the value is a bare version consumed as an image TAG, not a digest-pinnable image reference. config:best-practices' docker:pinDigests would try to append @sha256 and error the branch on every run.

Hold Node on major 24. The Renovate CLI (`make renovate-validate`) requires Node >= 24, and Node 25+ dropped bundled corepack. matchDepNames (not matchPackageNames) is required for the mise manager. Bump this rule and .mise.toml together once the CLI supports a newer major.

Group Go toolchain bumps into a single PR: the go.mod directive, the Dockerfile golang base image, and the .mise.toml `go` pin MUST land together or `make check-toolchain-alignment` fails. Must stay LAST so this groupName overrides the per-manager groups above.
